{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import Web.Scotty
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BC
import Data.IORef
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Crypto.Cipher.AES (AES256)
import Crypto.Cipher.Types (cipherInit, ecbEncrypt, BlockCipher)
import Crypto.Error (CryptoFailable(..))
import Data.Word (Word8)
import Data.Bits (xor)
import Control.Monad (when)
import Control.Monad.IO.Class (liftIO)
import System.Clock

type TokenStore = Map Text ByteString

masterKey :: ByteString
masterKey = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"

initCipher :: AES256
initCipher = case cipherInit masterKey of
  CryptoPassed c -> c
  CryptoFailed e -> error $ "Cipher init failed: " ++ show e

encryptToken :: ByteString -> ByteString
encryptToken plaintext =
  let padded = BS.take 16 (plaintext `BS.append` BS.replicate 16 0)
  in ecbEncrypt initCipher padded

-- | Constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks
constantTimeCompare :: ByteString -> ByteString -> Bool
constantTimeCompare a b
  | BS.length a /= BS.length b = False
  | otherwise = go 0 0
  where
    len = BS.length a
    go :: Int -> Word8 -> Bool
    go i acc
      | i >= len  = acc == 0
      | otherwise =
          let diff = BS.index a i `xor` BS.index b i
          in go (i + 1) (acc `Data.Bits.xor` diff)

-- | Verify an API token against stored encrypted tokens
verifyToken :: TokenStore -> Text -> ByteString -> IO Bool
verifyToken store userId suppliedToken = do
  case Map.lookup userId store of
    Nothing -> return False
    Just storedEncrypted -> do
      let suppliedEncrypted = encryptToken suppliedToken
      return $ constantTimeCompare storedEncrypted suppliedEncrypted

-- | Rate-limited authentication endpoint
authenticate :: IORef TokenStore -> IORef (Map Text TimeSpec) -> ActionM ()
authenticate storeRef rateLimitRef = do
  uid <- param "user_id"
  token <- param "token"
  store <- liftIO $ readIORef storeRef
  rateMap <- liftIO $ readIORef rateLimitRef
  now <- liftIO $ getTime Monotonic
  let lastAttempt = Map.lookup uid rateMap
  case lastAttempt of
    Just t | diffTimeSpec now t < TimeSpec 1 0 -> do
      status status429
      text "Rate limited"
    _ -> do
      liftIO $ modifyIORef' rateLimitRef (Map.insert uid now)
      result <- liftIO $ verifyToken store uid (TE.encodeUtf8 token)
      if result
        then json (Map.fromList [("status" :: Text, "authenticated" :: Text)])
        else do
          status status401
          text "Invalid credentials"

-- | Admin endpoint to provision tokens
provisionToken :: IORef TokenStore -> ActionM ()
provisionToken storeRef = do
  uid <- param "user_id"
  token <- param "token"
  let encrypted = encryptToken (TE.encodeUtf8 token)
  liftIO $ modifyIORef' storeRef (Map.insert uid encrypted)
  json (Map.fromList [("status" :: Text, "provisioned" :: Text)])

-- | Health check with timing diagnostics
healthCheck :: IORef TokenStore -> ActionM ()
healthCheck storeRef = do
  store <- liftIO $ readIORef storeRef
  let userCount = Map.size store
  json (Map.fromList [("users" :: Text, T.pack (show userCount))])

main :: IO ()
main = do
  storeRef <- newIORef Map.empty
  rateLimitRef <- newIORef Map.empty
  scotty 3000 $ do
    post "/auth" $ authenticate storeRef rateLimitRef
    post "/provision" $ provisionToken storeRef
    get "/health" $ healthCheck storeRef
